hero.title: Crowdfunding built on transparency, community and fair profit-sharing.
hero.text: Fundy brings interest-free funding to Uzbekistan's entrepreneurs, artisans and innovators. Support causes with donations, pre-order authentic rewards, or become a partner in real businesses through Musharakah.
hero.imageTitle: Connecting Uzbekistan's creators with community capital

models.title: Three funding models. Zero interest.
models.text: Fundy matches the funding to the project — philanthropic, product-based or a business partnership.

how.title: From idea to delivered milestones
how.text: Every project is checked, scored and funded in stages tied to real progress.
how.step1Text: Founders describe the project, an itemised budget in so'm, milestones and the funding terms.
how.step2Text: Fundy verifies the founder and registration, and scores the project out of 100.
how.step3Text: People across Uzbekistan back the project with Click, Payme, Uzcard or Humo (simulated in this demo).
how.step4Text: Money is released milestone by milestone as the founder shows proof of progress.

trust.title: Protecting backers and holding founders accountable.
trust.text: Fundy checks every founder, publishes every budget line, scores every project and releases money only against delivered milestones.
trust.item1Text: Founders verify their company registration (MChJ or YaTT) in Uzbekistan.
trust.item2Text: Funding is released in parts, only after proof of each stage.
trust.item3Text: Business plan, team, market, financials and risk are each scored.
trust.item4Text: Musharakah businesses share regular financial statements with their backers.

voices.title: Founders and backers on Fundy
voices.note: Illustrative examples for the demo — not real testimonials.
voices.quote1: Bank interest made expanding our greenhouses impossible. Musharakah let us partner with 42 people who care about sustainable farming.
voices.quote2: I backed the Samarkand studio and received a hand-woven scarf signed by the master weaver. The budget and updates were completely open.
voices.quote3: Our students finally have 3D printers. Releasing funds milestone by milestone gave every donor confidence.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Conventional loans charge interest whether a business succeeds or not. Fundy has no interest at all: projects are funded through donations, rewards, or Musharakah — where backers and founders share real profits and risks.
faq.q2: How does Musharakah work in practice?
faq.a2: Backers provide capital for productive assets such as greenhouses or machinery. The founder runs the business, and an agreed share of audited net profit (for example 25–30%) is paid to the backers regularly, with a clear exit horizon.
faq.q3: Is the money released all at once?
faq.a3: No. Funds are released in stages tied to milestones — for example, equipment delivered or construction finished — after the founder shows proof.
faq.a4: Projects from all sectors in Uzbekistan: technology, agriculture, crafts, food, education, healthcare, clean energy and social initiatives.
faq.a5: All amounts — budgets, rewards and profit shares — are in Uzbek so'm (UZS).
